class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleWipers
class.description: [RailVehicleWipers] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleWipers].

members.member: A sweep's time at a full valve with a full reservoir, in seconds.
How much of the way to the fastest the start of the valve's turn gives: the share at an opening is [code]1 - (1 - opening)^valve_sensitivity[/code].
A sweep's time at a valve just cracked open with a full reservoir, in seconds.
